Fields.Name: Ragdoll Param ID
Fields.Description: ID of the RagdollParam entry referenced by this ragdoll bone. -1 to not reference an entry.

Fields.Name: Damage Anim ID
Fields.Description:
The animation ID to play when this ragdoll bone is damaged.
Plays animation a99_XXXX in the TAE.

Fields.Name: NPC Part Group Index
Fields.Description:
Defines which NPC part group (if any) this ragdoll bone's collider is assigned.
Used for NPC part events in EMEVD or enemy weak points.
